Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1298
Claimant:
Beth Higgins
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
13 Apr 2024
Claim opened atfer a report that the insured vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant is
not represented by an attorney and is handling the claim directly.
27 Apr 2024
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed a left-turn collision and said the claimant's vehicle came across the
oncoming lane. The other driver's account matches the scene description and is consistent with the damage reported
so far.
28 Apr 2024
Reviweed scene photos and two independent witness statements. Both witnesses describe the same sequence of
events, and both place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact, as confirmed by the responding officer's
report.
28 Jun 2024
Inspected the vehicle. The front-quarter damage and the airbag deployment line up well with the reported impact
angle and speed. A few older scratches along the lower rear panel may predate this loss and have been noted for the
appraiser.
27 Jul 2024
Claimant reports a knee injury that required urgent care and then a longer course of physical therapy than is typical
for this type of injury. Medical records are being requested to confirm the treatment timeline and the diagnosis.
14 Aug 2024
Claimant's medical history shows a minor strain in the same knee several years ago, which healed fully according to
the prior provider's notes. The earlier episode does not appear to have required ongoing care, but it will be
considered when evaluating the current treatment.
23 Sep 2024
Claimant gave a follow-up statement adding a few small details about the moments before the collision, such as the
traffic signal color and the speed of the approaching car. The core account has not changed from the first report.
1 Dec 2024
A neighbor contacted the desk and stated the vehicle looked damaged a few weeks before the reported collision
date. The statement is being noted and will be checked against photos, repair estimates and the policy's coverage
history. The driver is named on the policy, and covearge is not in question at this stage.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
